entries.name: MCP Echo
entries.summary: Minimal local stdio MCP server exposing one echo tool; the reference end-to-end install target for the OpenAR extension hub.

entries.name: Benchmark Stats
entries.summary: Offline statistics for comparing benchmark accuracies: a Wilson interval for one score, an exact McNemar test for two systems on the same items, and how many items a given gap needs.

entries.name: Hugging Face
entries.summary: Search and inspect models, datasets, Spaces and papers on the Hugging Face Hub through Hugging Face's hosted MCP service; registers a connection, nothing is installed. Works anonymously; signing in is optional.

entries.name: Context7
entries.summary: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks via Upstash's hosted Context7 MCP service; registers a connection, nothing is installed.
